wiki.title: Bob Morgan (Illinois politician)
wiki.extract: Bob Morgan is a lawyer and politician who currently serves as Assistant Majority Leader and Floor Whip in the Illinois House of Representatives. A Democrat, he represents House District 58, which covers the Chicago North Shore suburbs, including all or parts of Bannockburn, Deerfield, Glencoe, Highwood, Highland Park, Lake Bluff, Lake Forest, Lincolnshire, Mettawa, Northbrook, and North Chicago.
